objective: Replace treatment-arm terminology with group terminology throughout the application while preserving legacy saved studies.

tasks.title: Migrate persisted study vocabulary to group terminology
tasks.scope: Raise the schema version and migrate v3 armVocabulary plus its provenance slot to groupVocabulary. Update new/default studies and all runtime consumers. Preserve v1-v3 import compatibility and never rename design.groups.
tasks.verification: Exercise v1, v2, v3, v4, malformed, and future-version migration paths; prove v3 values and provenance survive under groupVocabulary and new studies contain no armVocabulary key.

tasks.title: Replace generated and visible arm terminology with group
tasks.scope: Rename the derived StudyDocument design.arms and study.armVocabulary projections to groups and groupVocabulary, update every renderer and guided-example sentence, and update tests. Remove standalone arm/arms language from application source without changing scientific behavior.
tasks.verification: Search source and built output for standalone arm/arms terms, run renderer/studydoc/guided tests, and inspect generated Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, Overview, Study, and walkthrough copy for group terminology.

tasks.title: Adversarial regression and shipped-artifact verification
tasks.scope: Verify legacy-import compatibility, new-save terminology, all UI and generated artifacts, single-file assembly, and unchanged condition-matrix semantics.
tasks.verification: Run all JavaScript and Python tests, build the shipped artifact, diff-check, source/dist terminology searches, and live browser checks of Study, walkthrough, Overview, and generated report copy.
